title: Hallow Eye
body:
Description


The Hallow Eye is an eyeball located on the top of Hallow Trees. When attached to the tree, it will fire a laser that deals consistent damage to the closest player. The eye becomes a harmless decoration and can be claimed once the tree is chopped down.

Trivia

  • The Hallow Eye's texture and mesh came from a roblox hat accessory, the Ruby Eye.
